reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept INITIATE followed by one or more report-names, each an RD entry (XIII.4.4.3 SR1), refuse a missing operand or a non-report name, and for each named report in written order set sum counters to zero, LINE-COUNTER to zero and PAGE-COUNTER to one (GR1, GR4), with no 2002 rule that a contained program's report file be GLOBAL.

edition-consulted.switches: ctx.Edition.Edition.Has(2002): from 2002 a report defined in a containing program needs a GLOBAL FD; at 85 nothing is asked (X.4.6.4 GR2)
INITIATE reserved at all four editions

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: INITIATE of a containing program's GLOBAL report whose FD lacks GLOBAL compiles at 85 and is COBOL2392 at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf36_05 covers INITIATE; the multi-name form's per-report initialization, the re-INITIATE after TERMINATE, the non-report refusals and the contained-program form are not exercised

probes.expected: INITIATE RA RB initializes both reports; after TERMINATE a second INITIATE resets the sum counter to zero, LINE-COUNTER to 0 and PAGE-COUNTER to 1

probes.printed: COBOL1757 INITIATE 'V' / 'PFA' / 'DA': report-name-1 shall be defined by a report description entry
probes.expected: refused: a data item, a file-name and a report group are not report-names (SR1)
refused: at least one report-name is required

probes.printed: at 85: compiles and runs, INITIATE RP in the contained program writes WORLD; at 2023: COBOL2392 report 'RP' ... file description entry 'PFILE' does not contain a GLOBAL clause
probes.expected: legal at 85 (only SR1 applies; X.4.6.4 GR2), refused from 2002

reader.notes: The grammar prints INITIATE reportName+, and BindInitiate binds one BoundInitiate per name in written order, the GR4 decomposition. The only edition arm is the 2002 contained-report-file rule, correctly skipped at 85.
reader.at-2023: in1 not run at 2023; gl1's contained INITIATE is refused at 2023 by COBOL2392

refuter.evidence: ix_in1.cob (f): the reader's re-INITIATE probe did not discriminate (TERMINATE's CF FINAL resets the sum counter anyway), so this one sets SA=77, SK=66 and PAGE-COUNTER=9 after INITIATE, TERMINATEs with no GENERATE (no footing, values persist: AFTER TERM SA +077 SK +066 PC 9), sets PAGE-COUNTER=8, re-INITIATEs: SA +000 SK +000 PC 1 LC 0 (GR1 a-c for both a minor and a FINAL sum counter). in2bad.cob (b): INITIATE in a contained program of a non-GLOBAL RD of the container refused COBOL1757. in3bad.cob (b): a qualified report-name 'RA OF PFA' refused COBOL0307. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.4.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK §1985:XIII.4.4.3 SR1 (the text is in SR1).
